request.prompt: Instrumental compact playful anime naval adventure battle theme for clever coordinated shipgirl companions. Buoyant memorable middle-register clarinet melody, light viola staccato and soft acoustic guitar pulse, short mellow flute answers in the rests. A simple singable eight-bar theme, mostly stepwise motion and consonant thirds, regular question-and-answer phrases with gentle cadences. Stable bright major harmony and unhurried springy pulse. Brief soft opening, clear main melody, one short closely related contrast, then an obvious varied thematic return and a complete graceful ending near eighty-five seconds. Keep later development recognizably related to the original motif. Avoid strange melodic jumps, jagged chromatic runs, unrelated episodes, sudden harmonic turns, relentless fast notes, shrill flute ornaments and dense percussion. Entirely instrumental acoustic music: no singing, choir, speech, ocean ambience or weapon sounds. Clear one-at-a-time melodic lead, quiet supporting parts, comfortable middle registers and restrained dynamics.
